system.description:
[Trigger: Immediately After Damage] Used when you receive damage with the [Mental][Radiance][Poison] tag. You gain [Cancel (same tag as received damage):10]. If this effect is triggered multiple times, the [Cancel] is not overwritten, but the intensity is added. Magic-armored armor that grants pseudo-life through magic. It can generate a field to reduce damage based on specific attributes.

Liquefied Magic Crystal [Core Material] (60G) + Splint Mail (200G) + [Magic Catalyst 5] (40G) ×5 + Crafting Cost (260G)
